name: Ky Co
kicker: The closed cove on Phuong Mai
summary: Swim the cove the portal sets against the mountains on three sides, nearly 25 km from the city beach. The header prints 30,000–60,000 đồng and does not say whether that is a gate, a boat, or a range. Read the board. This is not the yellow crescent in the center.
timeNeeded: 60 minutes on the portal. A swim is longer.
getThere: Nearly 25 km from the city. The page does not split road and boat. Minutes are check on arrival.
heroCaption: The rocky cove at Kỳ Co, with turquoise water and a basket boat

notice.title: Read the price board
notice.body: The header prints 30,000–60,000 đồng. The prose does not say whether that is a gate, a boat, or a range. Do not treat it as Eo Gió’s 25,000 đồng ticket.

gettingThere: The page says Kỳ Co is nearly 25 km from the city and does not split that distance into road and boat. Minutes are check on arrival. The header says Phường Quy Nhơn Đông. The prose says xã Nhơn Lý.

legs.heading: From the city beach
legs.body: Nearly 25 km, by a mix the page does not split. Check the road time and the boat time on arrival.

closed: No weekly closing day is printed.
admissionNote: The header prints 30,000–60,000 đồng. The prose does not say what the range buys. Check the board at the site. Children and a boat fare are not separated on the page.
